headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: July 19, 2026**
article:
The Pittsburgh Pirates secured a convincing 7-1 victory over the Cleveland Guardians, with Jared Jones leading the way on the mound. Jones pitched 5.0 innings, striking out 9 batters and allowing just 1 earned run. In other news, the Chicago Cubs took down the Minnesota Twins 6-2, with Matthew Boyd earning the win.

Several teams have been impacted by injuries, with the Washington Nationals placing LHP PJ Poulin on the 15-day injured list due to a left flexor strain. The Nationals also transferred LHP Richard Lovelady from the 15-day injured list to the 60-day injured list due to a left triceps strain. The Baltimore Orioles transferred RHP Ryan Helsley from the 15-day injured list to the 60-day injured list due to right elbow discomfort.

The Chicago Cubs acquired RHP Aaron Civale from the Athletics in exchange for RHP Aiden Moffett. The Baltimore Orioles acquired RF Rudy Martin Jr. from the Kansas City Royals for cash. The St. Louis Cardinals acquired RHP Trey Pooser from the Tampa Bay Rays. The Washington Nationals traded CF Robert Hassell III to the Pittsburgh Pirates for cash. The Houston Astros traded RHP Lance McCullers Jr., LHP Colton Gordon, and cash to the Milwaukee Brewers for OF Jadyn Fielder.

top_news.title: **Pirates Take Down Guardians 7-1**
top_news.summary: The Pittsburgh Pirates secured a convincing 7-1 victory over the Cleveland Guardians, with Jared Jones leading the way on the mound. Jones pitched 5.0 innings, striking out 9 batters and allowing just 1 earned run.

top_news.title: **Pirates Fall to Guardians in 3-5 Showdown**
top_news.summary: The Cleveland Guardians secured a 3-5 victory over the Pittsburgh Pirates, snapping their opponent's winning streak. Travis Bazzana led the Pirates' offense with a 2-hit, 1-home run performance, including a crucial 8th homer that scored Steven Kwan.

top_news.title: **Cubs Take Down Twins 6-2**
top_news.summary: The Chicago Cubs secured a 6-2 victory over the Minnesota Twins, with Matthew Boyd earning the win. Kody Clemens led the Twins' offense with two home runs and two RBIs.

top_news.title: **Mets Fall Short in Philly, Phillies Take 6-1 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Philadelphia Phillies dominated the New York Mets, winning 6-1 behind a strong performance from Jesús Luzardo, who earned the win with 5.0 IP, 7 K, and 1 ER. Trea Turner led the Mets' offense with 3 hits, including a home run.

top_news.title: **White Sox Shut Out Blue Jays 3-0**
top_news.summary: The Chicago White Sox secured a shutout victory over the Toronto Blue Jays, with Trey Yesavage leading the way on the mound. Impact hitters for the White Sox included Colson Montgomery, Braden Montgomery, and Nathan Lukes.

top_news.title: **Dodgers Dominate Yankees in 8-2 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Los Angeles Dodgers secured an 8-2 win over the New York Yankees, with Shohei Ohtani and Max Muncy leading the charge for the Dodgers.

top_news.title: **Nationals' PJ Poulin Lands on Injured List**
top_news.summary: Washington Nationals left-handed pitcher PJ Poulin has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to a left flexor strain, effective retroactive to July 16, 2026.

top_news.title: **Cubs Acquire Aaron Civale in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Chicago Cubs have acquired right-handed pitcher Aaron Civale from the Athletics in exchange for right-handed pitcher Aiden Moffett. Civale joins the Cubs' roster following the trade.
